## What changed?

Describe the reader-facing outcome and keep the scope focused.
Use the [Wiki contribution guidelines](https://github.com/Atlasroar/Kenshi-Modding-Wiki/wiki/Contributing).
Website-maintainer documentation belongs in the Wiki, not public guide pages.

## Sources and review

For guide or media changes, identify the source, permissions, and evidence.
Describe any behavior that has not been tested in Kenshi.

## Validation

- [ ] I checked relevant links, headings, and source credits.
- [ ] I kept private notes, credentials, and local-file links out of the change.
- [ ] Text/media permissions and existing notices are preserved where applicable.
- [ ] Image placeholders or out-of-batch references were not silently removed.
- [ ] I ran the relevant checks, or explained why I could not below.

For visual changes, describe the mobile/desktop and light/dark review.
Screenshots are useful when available.

## Limitations

Record anything the reviewer needs to verify before publication.
